title: Blackwater Hydroelectric Dam
intent: The roadhead feeds a dam crest and an offset powerhouse. A guarded external stair and internal service stair connect crest, turbine floor and lower galleries without entering the spillway.

staging.logistics: Van is already staged on a prepared roadhead/service apron through expedition logistics. Travel to this remote region is a campaign transition; no new vehicle, ferry or flight gameplay is assumed.

circulation: Two full-height routes reach turbine floor. Lower gallery has a ring around isolated service rooms and two ways up. Observation pad is behind permanent rails; flowing water and working penstocks are outside legal hunter/ghost navigation.
systems: Turbine vibration, electrical fields, ventilation and cold water all have real sources. Isolation controls change machinery state visibly; ghost events cannot falsify a reading without an allowed world action.
campaign: Shift logs and mismatched alarm times underpin an industrial case. The crest provides a distant regional landmark without implying a whole reservoir is playable.
refine: Plan actual turbine machinery bays and guarded openings; the hall volume is not final plant geometry.
Engineer 6 m descents with switchback landings; schematic lines must not become unsupported ramps.
Study industrial electrical separation, acoustics and usable inspection paths before runtime authoring.
sources: https://www.nps.gov/pagr/learn/historyculture/hydroelectric-plant.htm (text inspected 2026-10-21: turbine-hall function; not a reproduced dam plan)
